mapper.select: SELECT i.interface_id, i.cron_expression, i.pattern_type, i.send_system_code, i.recv_system_code, d.property_name, d.property_value, q.sql_id, q.query FROM interface.tb_interface_info i LEFT JOIN interface.tb_interface_detail d ON i.interface_id = d.interface_id LEFT JOIN interface.tb_interface_query q ON i.interface_id = q.interface_id WHERE i.interface_id = #{interfaceId} AND i.use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT interface_id, cron_expression FROM interface.tb_interface_info WHERE interface_id IN
#{id}

SELECT i.interface_id, i.cron_expression, i.pattern_type, i.send_system_code, i.recv_system_code, d.property_name, d.property_value, q.sql_id, q.query FROM interface.tb_interface_info i LEFT JOIN interface.tb_interface_detail d ON i.interface_id = d.interface_id LEFT JOIN interface.tb_interface_query q ON i.interface_id = q.interface_id WHERE i.use_yn = 'Y' AND i.interface_id IN ( SELECT d1.interface_id FROM interface.tb_interface_detail d1 WHERE d1.property_name = 'RFC_FUNCTION_NAME' AND d1.property_value = #{functionName} ) AND i.interface_id IN
#{id}
